newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares dip at close amid ENI offer talk.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares dip at close amid ENI offer talk.

text.p: Italian shares ended weaker on Thursday after a subdued rise in early trade following Wednesday evening's 75-basis point cut in the discount rate to 7.5 percent.
The discount rate cut was factored into market, dealers said. "I think everyone was disappointed. It looks like the market had completely discounted the cut," said one.

Late unconfirmed talk of ENI share offer being lifted to 15 percent weighed on sentiment. Dealers had earlier seen investors making way for a larger ENI holding without distorting the Italian equity weighting in their portfolios.

Dealers said ENI shares eased on a large trade minutes before the market's close. The Treasury said on Wednesday it would substantially increase the amount of ENI shares being offered in response to strong demand.
A Treasury source said earlier on Thursday an announcement could be made today. ENI closed 1.45 percent off at 7,295.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.37 percent weaker at 9,852 while the Mib-30 index of blue chips was 0.56 percent easier at 14,834.

Pirelli slumped 4.14 percent to 2,710 in heavy volume. One broker noted some switching out of Pirelli and into Fiat, which ended 0.89 percent stronger at 4,215. Another said Pirelli was a target for profit-taking.
Telecom Italia Mobile weakened again in continued reaction to subscriber figures showing TIM shares end 3.08 percent off at 3,146.
